feed.title: DASH Lab
feed.subtitle: The DASH Lab at Wright State University advances data science for healthcare through applied research, wearable sensing, and human-centered AI.

entry.title: Special Thanks to Telelumen
entry.content: We wanted to express our gratitude to Steve Paolini at Telelumen for the donation of lighting and software to make the Correlated Color Temperature & Flow research project possible.
